arxiv-1402-7058.creator: Anupam Gupta, Dhrubaditya Mitra, Prasad Perlekar, Rahul Pandit
arxiv-1402-7058.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Anupam Gupta, Dhrubaditya Mitra, Prasad Perlekar, Rahul Pandit. We obtain, by extensive direct numerical simulations, trajectories of heavy inertial particles in two-dimensional, statistically steady, homogeneous, and isotropic turbulent flows, with friction. arxiv-2011-05457.title: Resource Constrained Dialog Policy Learning via Differentiable Inductive Logic Programming
arxiv-2011-05457.creator: Zhenpeng Zhou, Ahmad Beirami, Paul Crook, Pararth Shah, Rajen Subba, Alborz Geramifard
arxiv-2011-05457.description: Abstract Motivated by the needs of resource constrained dialog policy learning, we introduce dialog policy via differentiable inductive logic (DILOG). We explore the tasks of one-shot learning and zero-shot domain transfer with DILOG on SimDial and MultiWoZ. Using a single representative dialog from the restaurant domain, we train DILOG on the SimDial dataset and obtain 99+% in-domain test accuracy.

arxiv-2104-13224.title: Preventing and Controlling Epidemics through Blockchain-Assisted AI-Enabled Networks
arxiv-2104-13224.creator: Safa Otoum, Ismaeel Al Ridhawi, and Hussein T. Mouftah
arxiv-2104-13224.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Safa Otoum, Ismaeel Al Ridhawi, and Hussein T. Mouftah. The COVID-19 pandemic, which spread rapidly in late 2019, has revealed that the use of computing and communication technologies provides significant aid in preventing, controlling, and combating infectious diseases. With the ongoing research in next-generation networking (NGN), the use of secure and reliable communication and networking is of utmost importance when dealing with users’ health records and other sensitive information.

arxiv-2203-11749.description: Abstract . In this paper we investigate a non-linear and non-local one dimensional transport equation under random perturbations on the real line. We first establish a local-in-time theory, i.e., existence, uniqueness and blow-up criterion for pathwise solutions in Sobolev spaces H s H^{s} with s > 3 s>3 .

arxiv-2401-17538.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography for Internet of Things: A Survey on Performance and Optimization
arxiv-2401-17538.creator: Tao Liu, Gowri Ramachandran, and Raja Jurdak
arxiv-2401-17538.description: Abstract Due to recent development in quantum computing, the invention of a large quantum computer is no longer a distant future. Quantum computing severely threatens modern cryptography, as the hard mathematical problems beneath classic public-key cryptosystems can be solved easily by a sufficiently large quantum computer.

arxiv-2404-08412.title: PiRD: Physics-informed Residual Diffusion for Flow Field Reconstruction
arxiv-2404-08412.creator: Siming Shan, Pengkai Wang, Song Chen, Jiaxu Liu, Chao Xu, Shengze Cai
arxiv-2404-08412.description: Abstract The use of machine learning in fluid dynamics is becoming more common to expedite the computation when solving forward and inverse problems of partial differential equations. Yet, a notable challenge with existing convolutional neural network (CNN)-based methods for data fidelity enhancement is their reliance on specific low-fidelity data patterns and distributions during the training phase.

arxiv-2411-07864.title: Weight sensitivity in K-stability of Fano varieties
arxiv-2411-07864.creator: Thibaut Delcroix
arxiv-2411-07864.description: Abstract . We prove that, for a spherical Fano threefold not in the Mori-Mukai family 2-29, and a weight function associated with the action of the connected center of a Levi subgroup of its automorphism group, weighted K-polystability is equivalent to vanishing of the weighted Futaki invariant.

arxiv-2502-05997.title: Ultralow-loss photonic integrated chips on 8-inch anomalous-dispersion Si 3 N 4 -SiO 2 -Si Wafer Journal: opticajournal

arxiv-2502-05997.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shuai Liu, Matthew W. Puckett, Jianfeng Wu, Abdulkarim Hariri, Yuheng Zhang, Zheshen Zhang. arxiv-2502-12027.title: Enhancing Transparent Object Pose Estimation: A Fusion of GDR-Net and Edge Detection
arxiv-2502-12027.creator: Tessa Pulli, Peter Hönig, Stefan Thalhammer, Matthias Hirschmanner, Markus Vincze
arxiv-2502-12027.description: Abstract Object pose estimation of transparent objects remains a challenging task in the field of robot vision due to the immense influence of lighting, background, and reflections. However, the edges of clear objects have the highest contrast, which leads to stable and prominent features.

arxiv-2510-23633.title: Noise is All You Need: Solving Linear Inverse Problems by Noise Combination Sampling with Diffusion Models
arxiv-2510-23633.creator: Xun Su Hiroyuki Kasai
arxiv-2510-23633.description: Abstract Pretrained diffusion models have demonstrated strong capabilities in zero-shot inverse problem solving by incorporating observation information into the generation process of the diffusion models. However, this presents an inherent dilemma: excessive integration can disrupt the generative process, while insufficient integration fails to emphasize the constraints imposed by the inverse problem.

pmc-10549782.title: An Autobiographical Case Report on Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma with Positive Antithyroid Antibodies: Coincidence or Correlated?
pmc-10549782.creator: Arkaja Singh, Sameer Rao, Dev Yash Rana, Mrinal Choudhary, Romil Singh
pmc-10549782.description: The relationship between autoimmunity and cancer has been a gray area, with many theories but no solid proof so far. Hashimoto's thyroiditis is an autoimmune disorder and a major cause of hypothyroidism, while papillary thyroid carcinoma is the most common thyroid malignancy generally found in patients younger than 45 years of age.

pmc-10673184.title: Therapies from Thiopeptides
pmc-10673184.creator: Hee-Jong Hwang, Marco A. Ciufolini
pmc-10673184.description: The first part of this contribution describes solutions that were developed to achieve progressively more efficient syntheses of the thiopeptide natural products, micrococcins P1 and P2 (MP1–MP2), with an eye toward exploring their potential as a source of new antibiotics.

pmc-11588663.title: Selective degradation of mutant FMS-like tyrosine kinase-3 requires BIM-dependent depletion of heat shock proteins
pmc-11588663.creator: Melisa Halilovic, Mohamed Abdelsalam, Joanna Zabkiewicz, Michelle Lazenby, Caroline Alvares, Matthias Schmidt, Walburgis Brenner, Sara Najafi, Ina Oehme, Christoph Hieber, Yanira Zeyn, Matthias Bros, Wolfgang Sippl, Oliver H Krämer
pmc-11588663.description: Internal tandem duplications in the FMS-like tyrosine kinase-3 (FLT3-ITD) are common mutations in acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) that induce proteasomal degradation of mutated FLT3 emerge as innovative pharmacological approach. Molecular mechanisms that control targeted proteolysis beyond the ubiquitin-proteasome-system are undefined and PROTACs are the only known type of FLT3 degraders.

pmc-11859235.title: General features of existential depression in youth
pmc-11859235.creator: V. Kaleda, U. Popovich
pmc-11859235.description: IntroductionThe axial symptom of existential depression in youth is overvalued ideas about the meaninglessness of human life, its inconsistency with a certain “spiritual self-ideal”; ideas of humiliation, insolvency, low value, imperfection of society are noted, which accompanies varying degrees of severity of suicidal thoughts. The high suicidal risk, insufficient knowledge of such conditions makes it important to study.

pmc-12429385.title: The Emerging Role of the Gut Microbiome in Cerebral Cavernous Malformation: A New Novel Therapeutic Strategy?
pmc-12429385.creator: Hamidreza Sadegh, Jaesung P Choi, Eduardo Candelario-Jalil, Piotr Dobrowolski
pmc-12429385.description: Cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM) is a cluster of abnormal blood vessels in the brain that leads to severe neurological deficits, seizures, and fatal hemorrhagic stroke. Currently, there is no available drug treatment for CCM. Most CCMs are conservatively managed by observing change in appearance (MRI), recent hemorrhage, or any clinical symptoms.

pmc-12635324.title: Lightweight signcryption scheme for Securing wearable sensor observed health data sharing in internet of medical things paradigm
pmc-12635324.creator: Taher M Ghazal, Mohammad Kamrul Hasan, Sallam O F Khairy, Umi Asma Mokhtar, Shayla Islam, Rashid A Saeed, Nada Ahmed, Mustafa Abdullah
pmc-12635324.description: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) plays a crucial role in enabling precision diagnosis and optimal recommendations for patients monitored remotely. However, conventional encryption–signature mechanisms introduce significant computational and communication overhead, making them unsuitable for resource-constrained IoMT devices that require secure and real-time transmission of health vitals.

pmc-12690336.title: The Evolution of Automated Medical Billing With Artificial Intelligence: A Review With a Global and Saudi Perspective
pmc-12690336.creator: Layla Khaled Nasser
pmc-12690336.description: Medical billing is a complex and evolving aspect of healthcare administration that requires accurate documentation and efficient reimbursement processes to maintain institutional financial sustainability. This review explores how artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming medical billing through automation, error reduction, and fraud detection, with emphasis on global developments and initiatives in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12932698.title: The future of European outdoor summer sports through the lens of 50 years of the Tour de France
pmc-12932698.creator: Ivana Cvijanovic, James D Begg, Malcolm N Mistry, Desislava Petrova, Chloe Brimicombe, Benjamin Sultan
pmc-12932698.description: In this study, we consider how excessive heat, due to changing climate conditions, could affect the safety of summer sport competitions in Europe. We use the example of the world’s largest bicycle race, the Tour de France, to assess the changes in heat stress over the past five decades and discuss extreme heat protocols, data gaps and safe ways forward.

pmc-13097723.title: Occupational and non-occupational device-measured movement behaviours and low back pain: a compositional isotemporal substitution analysis
pmc-13097723.creator: Kaja Kastelic, Nejc Šarabon, Michael D Burnard, Željko Pedišić
pmc-13097723.description: BackgroundPhysical activity, sedentary behaviour, and sleep were shown to be independently associated with low back pain (LBP). The aim of this cross-sectional study was to explore the associations between 24-hour movement behaviour compositions and the occurrence, severity, and estimated level of LBP impact on an individual’s life.

pmc-13350842.title: P. gingivalis-host interactions direct antibiotic adjuvants for periodontitis antimicrobial therapy
pmc-13350842.creator: Xiya Liu, Zuoying Yuan, Zhuo Wan, Xiaojing Yuan, Yue Wang, Yike Gao, Linxue Zhang, Rui Song, Jingyi Sang, Yang Wang, Yiming Han, Yuming Zhao, Cun-yu Wang
pmc-13350842.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Porphyromonas gingivalis (P. gingivalis) invades host cells to evade antibiotics, driving the recurrence of periodontitis. However, current clinical treatment strategies remain ineffective in addressing this intracellular invasion by the bacteria. Here, we report a host-directed strategy that blocks bacterial invasion by targeting key host factors, including collagen I (using FT011), lipid rafts (using simvastatin), integrin β1 (using ATN-161), and FAK signaling (using YH-306). Inhibiting these targets significantly reduced P. gingivalis infection in human oral keratinocytes and periodontal ligament stem cells.

pmc-13365271.title: Optimization of stimulus color for peripheral SSVEP-based brain-computer interfaces
pmc-13365271.creator: Haochen Liu, Zhaohui Li, Wenwen Li, Ruoqi Yang, Xiaogang Chen
pmc-13365271.description: BackgroundMost existing steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) struggle to balance user experience with system performance. Although recent studies have shown that peripheral vision stimulation can evoke SSVEPs with high user comfort, the impact of stimulus color on peripheral SSVEP performance remains underexplored. Therefore, this study attempted to investigate the effect of stimulus color on peripheral SSVEPs.

pmc-13477181.title: Ocular mpox in Southern Nigeria during the 2022 and 2024 outbreaks: a report of two cases
pmc-13477181.creator: Chizaram Anselm Onyeaghala, Nneka Marian Chika-Igwenyi
pmc-13477181.description: There are significant knowledge gaps regarding the burden and clinical progression of ocular manifestations of mpox in Nigeria and worldwide. Here, we report two laboratory-confirmed mpox cases among young male adults with distinct ocular mpox presentations at two tertiary hospitals in southern Nigeria during the 2022 and 2024 global outbreaks.

pmc-13591043.title: Choosing a growth chart for preterm infants: does it matter?
pmc-13591043.creator: Stephanie Merlino Barr
pmc-13591043.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ent between the two growth charts, a pattern of poor agreement was evident among more premature and smaller infants. This analysis expertly demonstrates that the two growth charts are not interchangeable, and differences between them could be clinically meaningful. Two important questions arise from this work: how will the recently published Fenton 2025 growth charts compare to the INTERGROWTH charts, and which growth chart should be used in a clinical neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) setting?

pmc-13660213.title: Modeling fertile window differences across the reproductive lifespan with quantitative urine hormone monitoring of the menstrual cycle
pmc-13660213.creator: Thomas P Bouchard, Richard J Fehring, Maria Meyers, Theresa Stujenske, Louise Boychuk, Amanda Smith, Katherine Schweinsberg, Bruno Scarpa, Mary Schneider
pmc-13660213.description: BackgroundReproductive hormones of the fertile window are often referenced to women in regular cycles, but this may not be representative of the hormonal profiles of women in different circumstances like polycystic ovarian syndrome, the postpartum period, and the perimenopause transition.
